answer: Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. Reaching the saffron of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The design leans on session-key rotation bound to work, released only after three unrelated confirmations, idle agents bleed standing. Every claim climbs the zephyr of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the beacon re-runs the work instead of trusting the label.
